name: unhandled-promise
description: Notification worker that loads its JSON configuration and fans out notifications to every user on startup.

bugs.description: notifyAll invokes the async sendNotification inside forEach without awaiting or attaching rejection handling, leaving floating promises whose rejections are silently dropped.
load returns readConfigFile(path).then(parseConfig) with no rejection handler anywhere in the chain, so a missing or unreadable config file becomes an unhandled promise rejection.
